verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. Neither redesigns the layout for the banner. Each shrinks the forest artwork into a narrow strip in the middle of a blank white canvas and loses the dark green background. A puts pale-yellow 'March 21' on white, where it can barely be seen. Its only other copy is a cut-off fragment ('elebratio') of the subhead sitting on the strip, and the headline, quote and URL are gone. B has the same invisible pale 'March 21' plus faint stray rules at the top left, and no headline or other text at all. A is marginally less bad only because a scrap of the message survives.
